claims: As of late March 2026, 30-year fixed refinance rates generally hover in the mid-to-high 6% range.
As of late March 2026, 15-year fixed refinance rates are often in the mid-to-high 5% range.
Refinance rates have recently hit 7-month highs.
As of March 2026, 30-Year Fixed refinance rate is ~6.25% – 6.75%.
As of March 2026, 15-Year Fixed refinance rate is ~5.56% – 5.87%.
As of March 2026, 30-Year FHA/VA refinance rate is ~5.49% – 6.32%.
As of March 2026, 5/1 ARM refinance rate is ~6.02% – 6.62%.
A higher credit score (720+) and at least 20% equity typically secure the best rates and avoid private mortgage insurance (PMI).
